summary.text: Justin Kumar is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Paul Kendrick for a seat with no incumbent.
He describes himself as a local businessman who wants to focus on crime and safety, infrastructure and public education.

paragraphs.text: Justin Kumar earned a high school diploma from the University School of Milwaukee and a graduate degree from Northwestern in 2002, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a business owner and president.
Kumar advanced from the March 17, 2026 Republican primary for District 12.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he named crime and safety, bipartisan infrastructure solutions and public education as his key messages.
